issues.quote: Last week the Moon was a big round ball. Now it is a thin banana!
issues.problem: This timing is wrong, and it clashes with the script's own scenes 18 and 19. A full Moon is about 2 weeks away from the new Moon. One week after full, the Moon is a half Moon. It takes about 10 to 12 days or more to shrink to a thin crescent. A child could get the wrong idea about how fast the phases change.
issues.fix: Bối: Huy, look! Two weeks ago the Moon was a big round ball. Now it is a thin banana!
